task.title: Install the CLI from a checkout
task.shortdesc: Build the command from the OpenD repository and check that it runs.

context.p: The CLI is not published to npm yet, so you run it from a checkout. Everything it does happens on your machine: it never contacts a server.

step.cmd: Clone the repository and install its dependencies.

stepxmp.codeblock: git clone https://github.com/desktopmachineshop/opend.git cd opend pnpm install

step.cmd: Check the CLI runs: pnpm opend --help.
step.stepresult: It lists the validate, build and preview commands.

step.cmd: Optional: try it on the starter template.

stepxmp.codeblock: pnpm opend validate templates/docs-starter pnpm opend preview templates/docs-starter

result.p: pnpm opend is a shortcut for node packages/cli/dist/bin.js. To use the CLI from your own docs repository, run that file with its full path, for example node ~/src/opend/packages/cli/dist/bin.js validate ., or pass the docs folder to pnpm opend from the checkout.
